findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "read_declarations_page" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "premium-lock" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
